questions.prompt: The Eiffel Tower was the tallest man-made structure in the world for 41 years after its completion. How many meters tall is the Eiffel Tower (including antennas)?
questions.explanation: The Eiffel Tower stands at 330 meters (1,083 ft) tall, including its antennas, making it one of the most recognizable structures in the world since its completion in 1889.
